source.title: Training stochastic stabilized supralinear networks by dynamics-neutral growth

record.tranche_reason: Reports gradient-based training outcomes for biologically constrained SSNs on MNIST classification and probabilistic inference, outside the claim versions' specified settings.
record.gate_note: The reported classification metric is test accuracy, not training classification error. The paper does not test any version's specified conditions. Rows record training outcomes relevant to the broader claim; cited results from earlier work are excluded.
record.test_reason: The study evaluates its own method for training stochastic recurrent SSNs. MNIST test accuracy, posterior-moment matching costs, and runaway neural activity do not measure any claim version. Dynamical instability here is not learning-rate instability in V5. Batch normalization is cited but not tested.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is accurate: the authors conclude that dynamics-neutral growth enables effective stochastic SSN training for MNIST classification and sampling-based inference under a CIFAR-10-optimized GSM, while avoiding dynamical instability in their reported training attempts.
record.recipe_differences: The study trains stochastic stabilized supralinear recurrent networks by dynamics-neutral growth, optimizing with backpropagation through time and Adam; it does not use the claim versions' deep convolutional-network recipes.
record.method_sensitivity: The reported MNIST test accuracy differs by network E:I ratio and encoded input dimensionality; the paper also reports different GSM costs for ring-constrained and general SSNs.

fits_no_version.finding: SSNs achieve MNIST test accuracies of 0.949 and 0.952; corresponding MLP accuracies are 0.974 and 0.976.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Dynamics-neutral growth can train stochastic SSNs for MNIST classification with test accuracy approaching the tested MLP comparators.

fits_no_version.finding: None of 200 MNIST training runs encountered runaway activity; random-network trials were all unstable and shuffled-network trials were approximately 79% unstable.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Dynamics-neutral growth maintains dynamical stability during the tested stochastic SSN training runs.

fits_no_version.finding: The general SSN attains normalized posterior-moment cost 0.745 on the CIFAR-10-optimized GSM; the Gaussian ring model fails to converge and has cost approximately 10^4.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The proposed method trains an unconstrained SSN for a GSM inference target that the tested Gaussian ring model cannot fit.

fits_no_version.finding: None of 100 general-SSN training runs became dynamically unstable; shuffled and random controls had unstable-trial proportions of 0.446 and 1.0.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The proposed method maintains dynamical stability while training stochastic SSNs for the tested GSM inference task.

record.peer_reviewed: NeurIPS 2022, 36th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
record.problems: The text reports test accuracy rather than training classification error. Reliability measures concern instability, not classification error. Numerical training details are referred to supplementary material not included in the supplied text.
record.rows_left_out: No separate test-accuracy rows for logistic regression or Gaussian ring SSN (50:50) were included; Table 1 also reports encoded-50 logistic regression 0.914 and Gaussian ring SSN 0.223, and encoded-80 logistic regression 0.922. These comparator results do not directly establish training classification error. Earlier-work results cited in the paper were not included.

untested.parts: Training classification error in large convolutional networks on CIFAR-10/100, including random labels and size, stopping, or regularization comparisons.
Spurious local minima and extra student neurons in two-layer ReLU teacher-student problems.
Depth-dependent training degradation, identity shortcuts, and the specified initialization alternatives.
Activation-matched initialization, signal and gradient propagation, training speed and depth, and orthogonal versus Gaussian weights.
Learning-rate stability thresholds, loss recovery, curvature reduction, and edge-of-stability trajectories.
Batch-normalization effects on training speed and learning-rate tolerance, and Fixup comparisons.

record.verdict_notes: The study is not an original source for these versions, but it tests none of them. Its method-performance comparisons should not be treated as claim evidence. No omitted result bears on V1–V6.

versions.untested_parts: CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100 classification, convolutional networks, random or corrupted labels, training error, and the stated size, optimizer, and stopping comparisons.
Two-layer ReLU teacher-student problems and width-dependent spurious minima.
Depth comparisons, batch-normalized convolutional networks, identity shortcuts, and the cited special initialization or normalization-free residual recipes.
Activation-matched initialization comparisons, signal or gradient propagation, depth sweeps, and orthogonal versus Gaussian initialization.
Learning-rate stability thresholds, loss and curvature trajectories, and full-batch sharpness.
Batch normalization comparisons and Fixup residual-network comparisons.
